notes: Effort: big lifts stop 1–2 reps short of failure. Isolation moves stop 0–1 short, and the last set can go to failure (on machines, cables and dumbbells only).
A1/A2 means alternate: do A1, rest as listed, do A2, rest, then repeat. Each muscle still gets 3–4 min, so it saves time without costing gains.

Progression: hit the top of the rep range on every set at the target effort, then add the smallest jump next time (+2.5 kg on the bar, the next dumbbell, or the next pin). If reps drop two sessions in a row, take 5–10% off and build back.
Myo-reps (last lateral-raise set): go to failure, rest 5 slow breaths, do 3–5 reps, and repeat three times. Counts as about one extra set.
Readiness: if Oura readiness is under 70 or HRV sits more than about 10% under your normal for 2+ days, still train, but drop the last set of each exercise and don't add weight.
3-day week: do Day 1, Day 2, Day 3, add 1 lateral-raise set to Days 1 and 3, and skip Day 4. Next week starts again at Day 1.

Neck: the gym plan has no extra neck work, and your physio's programme covers that. Do physio exercises after lifting or at another time, not right before. No shrugs, upright rows or loaded carries. Share this plan with your physio.
Cardio: one 4×4 interval session (bike) and 1–2 easy zone-2 sessions of 30–40 min a week, on non-lifting days or at least 3 h away from lifting. Details are in plan v2.

Spain 26–31 Oct: Travel A and Travel B mornings (45 min). Deload 16–22 Nov: same exercises, about half the sets, same weights, 3–4 reps in reserve. Wedding week: one light pump session on Mon 23 Nov, then rest.

sessions.name: Day 1 · Upper A · Strength + width
sessions.focus: Bench and pull-up strength, upper chest, side delts. About 50 min. Supersets: do A1, rest, A2, rest, repeat.
warmup: 2 min easy bike or arm swings
1 light set of cable rear-delt flyes or face pulls ×15 (skip if physio already did scapular work today)
Bench ramp: empty bar ×10, 45 kg ×5, 55 kg ×3, 60 kg ×1
Neck: nothing extra here. Do your physio exercises after the session or at another time of day

exercises.name: A1 · Bench press
exercises.target: 65 kg: get 6, 6, 6, then go to 67.5 kg
exercises.notes: Stop 1–2 reps short of failure. Shoulder blades pinched, feet planted, chin neutral (don't push the head into the bench).
exercises.how: Lower the bar to mid-chest under control, touch, press up and slightly back. Feet push into the floor the whole set.
exercises.pair: Superset: do A1, rest 2 min, do A2, rest 2 min, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: A2 · Pull-ups
exercises.target: Bodyweight: when you get 8, 8, 8, add 2.5 kg (dumbbell between the feet or a belt)
exercises.notes: Stop 1–2 reps short of failure. Full hang at the bottom, drive the elbows to the hips. Don't crane the neck to the bar.
exercises.how: From a dead hang, pull until your chin clears the bar, then lower all the way down. No kipping. Last 1–2 reps should be slow but clean.
exercises.pair: Superset: do A1, rest 2 min, do A2, rest 2 min, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: B1 · Low-incline DB press (15–30°)
exercises.target: First time: about 22–24 kg per hand, aim for 10 reps with 2 in reserve, then adjust
exercises.notes: Upper chest. Lower to a deep stretch and pause for 1 s at the bottom. Stop 1–2 reps short of failure.
exercises.how: Bench on the first or second notch (15–30°). Lower the dumbbells until you feel a stretch across the upper chest, pause 1 s, press up and in.
exercises.pair: Superset: do B1, rest 90 s, do B2, rest 90 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: B2 · Chest-supported row (machine or DB on incline bench)
exercises.target: First time: find 10 reps with 2 in reserve
exercises.notes: Upper back and lats, without loading the lower back. Chest stays on the pad and the neck stays relaxed: no shrugging.
exercises.how: Lie chest-down on an incline bench (or a row machine pad), arms hanging. Pull the elbows back to your hips, squeeze 1 s, lower to a full stretch.
exercises.pair: Superset: do B1, rest 90 s, do B2, rest 90 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: C1 · Cable lateral raise, one arm
exercises.target: 3.4 kg: when the first set reaches 20, move to 5.7 kg. Last set: myo-reps (see notes)
exercises.rest: Go straight into C2, then rest 60 s
exercises.notes: Cable behind the body, start from the stretch. Lead with the elbow, no shrug. 0–1 reps in reserve. Last set: after failure, rest 5 breaths and do 3–5 more reps, three times.
exercises.how: Stand side-on to a low cable with the handle crossing behind you. Raise out to the side to shoulder height, leading with the elbow, and lower slowly to the stretch. Myo-reps on the last set: go to failure, take 5 slow breaths, do 3–5 more, three times.
exercises.pair: Pair: do C1 (both arms), go straight into C2, then rest 60 s.

exercises.name: C2 · Overhead cable triceps extension
exercises.target: First time: find 12 reps with 1 in reserve
exercises.notes: Rope over your head, facing away from the stack. Get a full stretch behind the head. Keep the ribs down and the neck neutral.
exercises.how: Rope on a high or mid cable, face away, elbows by your ears. Let the hands drop behind your head for a deep stretch, then straighten the arms fully.
exercises.pair: Pair: after C1, do C2, rest 60 s, back to C1.

sessions.purpose: Build bench and pull-up strength, plus upper chest, side delts and triceps.

sessions.name: Day 2 · Lower A · Squat + hamstrings
sessions.focus: Squat strength, hamstrings in the stretch, plus side-delt and calf top-up. About 47 min.
warmup: If the bar on the upper back irritates the neck, use a safety-squat bar or swap to hack squat (same sets)

exercises.name: Back squat (or hack squat)
exercises.target: Hack 90 kg (incl. 47.5 sled)
exercises.notes: Stop 2 reps short of failure. A low-bar position takes pressure off the neck. Brace, hit depth, eyes forward and down.
exercises.how: Ramp up in a few sets, then do 3 working sets. Brace like you're about to be punched, sit down between the hips to at least parallel, drive up. Stop with 2 reps left in the tank.
exercises.pair: Straight sets: rest 3 min between sets. Not paired, so you're fresh.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.target: 60 kg, aim 3×8
exercises.notes: Hips back to a deep hamstring stretch, bar close to the legs. Straps are fine. Shoulders down, no shrugging, neck neutral.
exercises.how: Soft knees, push the hips back and slide the bar down the thighs until you feel a strong hamstring stretch (usually just below the knee). Stand up by squeezing the glutes.
exercises.pair: Straight sets: rest 2 min.

exercises.name: C1 · Seated leg curl
exercises.target: 45 kg
exercises.rest: Go straight into C2, then rest 60 s
exercises.notes: Seated, not lying: it trains the hamstrings at a longer length. Last set to failure, then 3–5 bottom-half partials.
exercises.how: Pad just above the heels, thigh pad tight. Curl all the way, lower slowly. On the last set, after failure, add 3–5 short reps in the bottom (stretched) half.
exercises.pair: Superset: do C1, rest 60 s, do C2, rest 60 s, repeat until all sets are done. The pair works because legs and shoulders don't compete.

exercises.name: C2 · Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.notes: Seated or leaning slightly forward, stop just above parallel, no shrug. Last set: myo-reps.
exercises.how: Slight forward lean, raise the dumbbells out to the side to just above shoulder height, lower for 2–3 s. Light enough to do it without swinging.
exercises.pair: Superset: do C1, rest 60 s, do C2, rest 60 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: D1 · Leg extension
exercises.target: 45 kg
exercises.rest: Go straight into D2, then rest 60 s
exercises.notes: Lean back a little to stretch the front of the thigh. Last set to failure.
exercises.how: Back rest slightly reclined for a quad stretch. Kick up to straight, squeeze 1 s, lower under control.
exercises.pair: Superset: do D1, rest 60 s, do D2, rest 60 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: D2 · Standing calf raise
exercises.target: First time: 12 reps with 1 in reserve
exercises.notes: 2 s pause in the deep stretch at the bottom. Last set: finish with bottom-half partials.
exercises.how: Balls of the feet on the edge, drop the heels into a deep stretch and hold 2 s, then rise as high as you can. Don't bounce.
exercises.pair: Superset: do D1, rest 60 s, do D2, rest 60 s, repeat until all sets are done.

sessions.purpose: Squat strength and hamstrings, with a side-delt and calf top-up between leg exercises.

sessions.name: Day 3 · Upper B · Shoulders + V-taper
sessions.focus: Overhead press, lat width, upper chest, side and rear delts, arms. About 45 min, or about 50 with the optional arm block.
warmup: 2 min easy bike or arm swings
1 light set each of DB press ×12 and pulldown ×12
Neck: nothing extra here. Physio exercises go after the session or at another time of day

exercises.name: A1 · Seated DB shoulder press
exercises.target: 20 kg: get 3 × 10, then 22 kg
exercises.notes: Back supported, don't flare the ribs, chin neutral. Stop 1–2 reps short of failure.
exercises.how: Bench upright with back support. Start with the dumbbells at ear height, press up until the arms are straight, lower back to ear height. Ribs down, no arching.
exercises.pair: Superset: do A1, rest 90 s, do A2, rest 90 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: A2 · Lat pulldown (neutral or shoulder-width grip)
exercises.target: First time: 10 reps with 2 in reserve
exercises.notes: Full stretch at the top, elbows to the hips. Torso stays still and the neck stays relaxed.
exercises.how: Lean back slightly, pull the bar to the upper chest by driving the elbows down to your sides, then let the arms go fully straight at the top for the lat stretch.
exercises.pair: Superset: do A1, rest 90 s, do A2, rest 90 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: B1 · Low-to-high cable fly
exercises.target: First time: 12 reps with 1 in reserve
exercises.notes: Upper chest. Start with the hands low and slightly behind you for the stretch, then sweep up to chin height.
exercises.how: Pulleys at the bottom. Step forward, hands low and slightly behind you, then sweep up and together to chin height with a slight bend in the elbows. This hits the upper chest.
exercises.pair: Superset: do B1, rest 75 s, do B2, rest 75 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: B2 · Seated cable row (neutral grip)
exercises.target: First time: 12 reps with 1 in reserve
exercises.notes: Let the shoulder blades travel forward to a stretch, then row to the lower ribs. No shrugging.
exercises.how: Sit tall, let the weight pull the shoulders forward for a stretch, then row the handle to the lower ribs and squeeze the shoulder blades together.
exercises.pair: Superset: do B1, rest 75 s, do B2, rest 75 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: C1 · Machine or cable lateral raise
exercises.target: First time: 15 reps with 1 in reserve. Last set: myo-reps
exercises.rest: Go straight into C2, then rest 60 s
exercises.notes: Use a different tool from Day 1 (a machine if the gym has one). Bottom half is where most of the growth stimulus is, so never cut the bottom.
exercises.how: Lateral-raise machine, or a cable from behind the body if there's no machine. Raise to shoulder height, lower slowly, and never cut the bottom half short. Myo-reps on the last set.
exercises.pair: Pair: do C1, go straight into C2, then rest 60 s.

exercises.name: C2 · Reverse pec-deck (rear delts)
exercises.target: First time: 15 reps with 1 in reserve
exercises.notes: Arms slightly below shoulder height, pinkies leading, no shrugging. This is the posture work, replacing extra face pulls and Y-raises.
exercises.how: Face the pec-deck, handles at shoulder height. Sweep the arms back in a wide arc until they're in line with the body, pinkies leading. Slow on the way back.
exercises.pair: Pair: after C1, do C2, rest 60 s, back to C1.

exercises.name: D1 · Incline DB curl (optional if short on time)
exercises.target: First time: 10 reps with 1 in reserve
exercises.rest: Go straight into D2, then rest 60 s
exercises.notes: Bench at about 45°, arms hanging behind you for the long-head stretch. Last set to failure.
exercises.how: Optional, do it only if you have time. Bench at 45°, arms hanging straight down behind your body. Curl up without moving the elbows forward, lower to a full stretch.
exercises.pair: Superset: do D1, rest 60 s, do D2, rest 60 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: D2 · Rope pushdown (optional if short on time)
exercises.target: First time: 12 reps with 1 in reserve
exercises.notes: Elbows pinned, full lockout. Last set to failure.
exercises.how: Optional. Rope on a high cable, elbows pinned to your sides. Push down until the arms are locked straight, split the rope at the bottom.
exercises.pair: Superset: do D1, rest 60 s, do D2, rest 60 s, repeat until all sets are done.

sessions.purpose: Shoulders and V-taper: overhead press, lat width, upper chest, side and rear delts.

sessions.name: Day 4 · Lower B · Legs + lats + delts
sessions.focus: Quads and glutes with machines, hamstrings, plus a third lat session and a fourth side-delt session. About 47 min.
warmup: Leg press ramp: 2 lighter sets ×10 and ×5

exercises.name: Leg press (or hack squat)
exercises.target: First time: 10 reps with 2 in reserve
exercises.notes: Deep: knees well past 90°, lower back stays on the pad. Stop 1–2 reps short of failure.
exercises.how: Feet shoulder-width in the middle of the platform. Lower until the knees are well past 90° without the lower back peeling off the pad, then press up (don't lock out hard).
exercises.pair: Straight sets: rest 2 min.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat (dumbbells)
exercises.target: First time: 10 per leg with 2 in reserve
exercises.notes: Long stride, torso slightly forward for the glutes. Hold the dumbbells low (no traps).
exercises.how: Back foot on a bench, front foot a long stride ahead. Drop the back knee straight down, lean slightly forward, push up through the front heel. All reps on one leg, then switch.
exercises.pair: Straight sets: do both legs, rest 75 s.

exercises.name: C1 · Lying leg curl
exercises.target: First time: 12 reps with 1 in reserve
exercises.rest: Go straight into C2, then rest 60 s
exercises.notes: Hips pressed into the pad. Last set to failure, then 3–5 bottom-half partials.
exercises.how: Lie face down, pad just above the heels, hips pressed into the bench. Curl up, lower slowly. Last set: to failure, then 3–5 bottom-half partials.
exercises.pair: Superset: do C1, rest 60 s, do C2, rest 60 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: C2 · One-arm cable pulldown (half-kneeling)
exercises.target: First time: 12 per arm with 1 in reserve
exercises.notes: Reach up for the full lat stretch, pull the elbow to the hip. Neck relaxed, no shrugging.
exercises.how: Half-kneel beside a high cable, one hand on the handle. Reach up for a full lat stretch, then pull the elbow down to your hip. All reps one arm, then the other.
exercises.pair: Superset: do C1, rest 60 s, do C2, rest 60 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: D1 · Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.target: Lighter than Day 2: about 6–8 kg, 20 reps. Last set: myo-reps
exercises.rest: Go straight into D2, then rest 60 s
exercises.notes: High reps for the side delts. Strict, no shrug.
exercises.how: Same as Day 2 but lighter and for higher reps (15–25). Strict, no shrugging. Myo-reps on the last set.
exercises.pair: Superset: do D1, rest 60 s, do D2, rest 60 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: D2 · Seated calf raise
exercises.target: First time: 12 reps with 1 in reserve
exercises.notes: 2 s pause at the bottom stretch. Last set: bottom-half partials.
exercises.how: Knees under the pad, balls of the feet on the edge. Drop the heels into a deep stretch, hold 2 s, rise up. This hits the lower calf (soleus).
exercises.pair: Superset: do D1, rest 60 s, do D2, rest 60 s, repeat until all sets are done.

sessions.purpose: Quads and glutes on machines, hamstrings, plus a third lat session and a fourth side-delt session.

sessions.name: Travel A · 45 min (Spain)
sessions.focus: Hotel or commercial gym, morning. Push, pull, legs and delts in about 41 min. If the gym has dumbbells only or machines only, use the swaps in the notes.
warmup: 3 min brisk walk, bike or stairs
1 light set of the first two exercises ×12

exercises.name: A1 · DB bench press (or machine chest press)
exercises.target: About 26–28 kg per hand, or use RIR: stop 1–2 reps short of failure
exercises.notes: Dumbbells only: DB bench. Machines only: chest press. No bench: push-ups with feet raised, to 1–2 reps short of failure.
exercises.how: Dumbbells start at chest level, press up and slightly together, lower to a good stretch. If there are no heavy dumbbells, do push-ups with feet raised and stop 1–2 reps short of failure.
exercises.pair: Superset: do A1, rest 90 s, do A2, rest 90 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: A2 · Pull-ups (or lat pulldown)
exercises.target: Bodyweight, 1–2 reps short of failure
exercises.notes: Machines only: pulldown. No bar: one-arm DB row (3 × 10–12 per arm).
exercises.how: Same as at home: dead hang, chin over the bar, full lowering. No bar? Do a pulldown or one-arm DB row.
exercises.pair: Superset: do A1, rest 90 s, do A2, rest 90 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: B1 · Goblet squat (or leg press)
exercises.target: Heaviest dumbbell, 1–2 reps short of failure
exercises.notes: Dumbbells only: goblet squat, or Bulgarian split squat if the heaviest dumbbell is too light. Machines only: leg press.
exercises.how: Hold one heavy dumbbell at your chest, sit down between the knees with the chest up, stand. If the heaviest dumbbell feels easy, slow the lowering to 3 s or switch to Bulgarians.
exercises.pair: Superset: do B1, rest 75 s, do B2, rest 75 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: B2 · One-arm DB row (or seated cable or machine row)
exercises.target: 1–2 reps short of failure
exercises.notes: Hand on a bench, pull to the hip, no shrugging.
exercises.how: One hand and knee on a bench, flat back. Pull the dumbbell to your hip, lower to a full stretch. All reps one arm, then the other.
exercises.pair: Superset: do B1, rest 75 s, do B2, rest 75 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: C1 · DB lateral raise
exercises.target: 1 rep short of failure. Last set: myo-reps
exercises.rest: Go straight into C2, then rest 45 s
exercises.notes: Machines only: machine or cable lateral raise.
exercises.how: Same as at home. Strict, no swinging. Myo-reps on the last set.
exercises.pair: Pair: do C1, go straight into C2, then rest 45 s.

exercises.name: C2 · Overhead DB triceps extension
exercises.target: 1 rep short of failure
exercises.notes: One dumbbell held in both hands, seated.
exercises.how: Seated, one dumbbell in both hands overhead. Lower behind the head to a deep stretch, then straighten.
exercises.pair: Pair: after C1, do C2, rest 45 s, back to C1.

sessions.purpose: Spain morning session: push, pull, legs and delts, with swaps for any hotel gym.

sessions.name: Travel B · 45 min (Spain)
sessions.focus: Hotel or commercial gym, morning. Shoulders, lats, hamstrings, upper chest, about 45 min. If you only get 30 min, do blocks A and C.
warmup: 3 min brisk walk, bike or stairs

exercises.name: A1 · Seated DB shoulder press (or machine press)
exercises.target: 20 kg, as at home
exercises.notes: Back supported, chin neutral.
exercises.how: Same as Day 3 at home. Back supported, dumbbells from ear height to straight arms.
exercises.pair: Superset: do A1, rest 90 s, do A2, rest 90 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: A2 · Lat pulldown (or pull-ups)
exercises.target: 1–2 reps short of failure
exercises.notes: Dumbbells only: pull-ups if there's a bar, otherwise a DB pullover on a bench (3 × 12).
exercises.how: Same as Day 3. No machine? Pull-ups, or a DB pullover lying across a bench.
exercises.pair: Superset: do A1, rest 90 s, do A2, rest 90 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: B1 · DB Romanian deadlift (or machine leg curl)
exercises.target: Heaviest dumbbells, 1–2 reps short of failure
exercises.notes: Deep hamstring stretch. Straps are fine. Machines only: seated leg curl.
exercises.how: Dumbbells in front of the thighs, push the hips back until you feel a deep hamstring stretch, stand up by squeezing the glutes. Back flat, neck neutral.
exercises.pair: Superset: do B1, rest 90 s, do B2, rest 90 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: B2 · Incline DB press (or incline machine press)
exercises.target: 1–2 reps short of failure
exercises.notes: No incline bench: flat DB press or deficit push-ups.
exercises.how: Bench on a low incline. Lower to a deep stretch at the upper chest, pause 1 s, press.
exercises.pair: Superset: do B1, rest 90 s, do B2, rest 90 s, repeat until all sets are done.

exercises.name: C1 · DB lateral raise
exercises.target: 1 rep short of failure. Last set: myo-reps
exercises.rest: Go straight into C2, then rest 45 s
exercises.how: Same as at home. Myo-reps on the last set.
exercises.pair: Pair: do C1, go straight into C2, then rest 45 s.

exercises.name: C2 · Rear-delt fly (DB bent-over or reverse pec-deck)
exercises.target: 1 rep short of failure
exercises.notes: Chest on an incline bench takes load off the lower back and neck.
exercises.how: Chest on an incline bench, dumbbells hanging. Sweep the arms out wide, pinkies leading, to shoulder height. Light weight, slow.
exercises.pair: Pair: after C1, do C2, rest 45 s, back to C1.

exercises.name: DB reverse lunge
exercises.target: 1–2 reps short of failure
exercises.notes: Skip it if you're short on time: legs are on maintenance this week.
exercises.how: Optional, skip if you're short on time. Step back into a lunge until the back knee nearly touches the floor, push back up through the front heel.
exercises.pair: Straight sets: do both legs, rest 60 s.

sessions.purpose: Spain morning session: shoulders, lats, hamstrings and upper chest. Only 30 min? Do blocks A and C.

log.coachNote: Old plan (v1) Day 1, 22 of 23 sets. Bench 65 × 6, 6, 5, 4 and pull-ups BW × 6, 6, 4, 3 set the starting points for plan v2. DB press reached 20 kg × 8, laterals 3.4 kg × 11–13. Plan v2 starts with Day 2 (Lower A).

First full Lower A after three skips, 18/18 sets on a 33 ms HRV day at RIR 1–2. Hack squat: 97.5 was ~1 RIR, so 87.5 for back-off sets. Next time: hack squat 90 kg × 6–8, RDL 60 kg aiming for 3×8. Took ~75 min, so cut rests to 60–90 s between superset rounds.

howItWorks.d: RIR means reps in reserve: how many more clean reps you could do. Big lifts stop at RIR 1–2. Isolation exercises stop at RIR 0–1, and their last set can go to failure. Never take barbell lifts to failure.

Stay at a weight until every set hits the top of the rep range, then add the smallest jump next time (+2.5 kg on the bar, the next dumbbell or the next pin). If reps drop two sessions in a row, take 5–10% off and build back up.
Do A1, rest the listed time, do A2, rest, repeat. The two exercises don't compete (push with pull, legs with shoulders), so each muscle still gets 3–4 min, and the session is about a third shorter.
Last lateral-raise set only: go to failure, take 5 slow breaths, do 3–5 more reps, and repeat three times. It counts as about one extra set.
For new exercises, start a bit light (RIR 2–3) and log what you lift. From week 3 you push closer to failure.
Do Day 1, 2 and 3, add one lateral-raise set (myo-reps) to Days 1 and 3, and skip Day 4. Next week starts at Day 1 again.

Once a week, 4×4 on a bike: 8 min easy, then 4 × 4 min hard (could just about hold a conversation in single words) with 3 min easy between. Plus 1–2 zone-2 sessions of 30–40 min: brisk incline walk or easy bike where you can still speak in full sentences and breathe through your nose. Keep the 4×4 away from lifting and not the day before a leg day.

There's no extra neck work in the gym, because your physio covers it. Do physio after lifting or at another time of day, not right before. No shrugs, upright rows, loaded carries or deadlifts. Show your physio this plan; their advice wins.
If readiness is under 70, or HRV is more than about 10% under your normal for 2+ days, still train, but drop the last set of each exercise and don't add weight.
Travel A on Tue and Travel B on Thu in the morning (optional A again on Fri), 45 min max. Each exercise lists hotel-gym swaps. Send me 'starting' when you walk in. Walk a lot for cardio.
Same exercises and weights, about half the sets (3 becomes 2), stopping 3–4 reps short. You recover fully without losing anything.
Mon 23 Nov: light Day 3 pump (2 sets each, ~30 min). Tue: optional easy 20 min, no legs to failure. Wed: rest and walk. Thu 26 Nov: you arrive fresh, full and not sore.

Same in trained lifters: Refalo et al. 2024
Rest periods: Singer, Schoenfeld et al. 2024
Supersets save ~37% time, same gains: Zhang et al. 2025
Training in the stretch: Wolf, Nippard, Schoenfeld et al. 2025
Side-delt volume and frequency: RP / Israetel
Cardio doesn't blunt muscle: Schumann et al. 2022
4×4 intervals for VO2max: Helgerud et al. 2007
Holding muscle on low volume: Bickel et al. 2011
